list.emptyDescription: Upload a CSV, dry-run validation, then commit to the CRM.

wizard.title: New import
wizard.noHeaders: Could not read the header row
wizard.mappingNote: Connect CSV columns to CRM fields. Unmapped columns are ignored.
wizard.duplicateLink: Link duplicate rows to existing records
wizard.mappingRequired: Map at least one CSV column before validating.
wizard.confirmNote: Uploading only runs validation (dry-run). CRM writes happen in the commit step on the detail screen.
wizard.basisNote: Newly imported addresses start with an unverified send basis.
wizard.fileTooLarge: CSV files up to 20 MB are supported

detail.commitDescription: Applies the validated snapshot (validation hash) to the CRM. This cannot be undone.
detail.invalidReject: Abort everything if any row is invalid
detail.partialNote: Partial success reports actual imported/skipped/error counts.
detail.commitOnlyReady: Only a validated (ready) import can be committed.
detail.snapshotMismatch: The validation snapshot changed. Refresh to the latest state and retry.
detail.versionConflict: Another change was applied first. Refresh and try again.
detail.forbidden: You do not have permission to process this import.
detail.failedRowsDescription: Download invalid/skipped rows as CSV or edit them here, then start a new import.
detail.failedRowsLoadedNote: Preview loaded {loaded} failed rows. The CSV download fetches all pages.
detail.downloadFailed: Could not load all failed rows for the CSV.
detail.basisNote: Importing never grants marketing consent to new addresses. Send basis is verified separately.

export.title: Request export
export.description: Exports allowlisted CRM fields asynchronously. Track progress in Operations › Jobs.
export.fieldsRequired: Enter at least one exportable field.
